name: duopore-public-utility-quote-cost-compare
description: Compare utility quotes using the rates, fees and usage you enter.

interface.longDescription: Compare utility quotes using the rates, fees and usage you enter. Choose a time period and add usage rates, fixed fees, setup costs, discounts and refundable deposits. See costs side by side, with deposits kept clear. The app does not find tariffs or check suppliers. Use matching usage and one currency for a fair comparison.
defaultPrompt: Compare the total cost of these utility quotes.
Show setup fees, recurring costs and deposits separately.

positive.prompt: Use Utility Quote Cost Compare with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"months":12,"monthlyUnits":100,"quotes":[{"id":"U1","unitRate":0.2,"monthlyFee":10,"setupFee":20,"deposit":50,"discountTotal":0},{"id":"U2","unitRate":0.15,"monthlyFee":15,"setupFee":0,"deposit":100,"discountTotal":0}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"Lowest supplied 12-month nonrefundable cost: 360.","rows":[{"quoteRef":"U2","rank":1,"monthlyUsageAndFee":30,"periodNonrefundableCost":360,"refundableDeposit":100,"periodCashRequirement":460,"comparisonMonths":12},{"quoteRef":"U1","rank":2,"monthlyUsageAndFee":30,"periodNonrefundableCost":380,"refundableDeposit":50,"periodCashRequirement":430,"comparisonMonths":12}],"warnings":["Use one supplied currency. Planning arithmetic only; no live prices, financial advice or affordability guarantee.","Only explicitly supplied fees and discounts are included. Deposits are excluded from nonrefundable cost but included in cash needs; recovery is not guaranteed."]}

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
